subject: Private/on-prem expansion + term extension for CloudHealth Systems
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@cloudhealthsys.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: audrey.lane@cloudhealthsys.com; procurement@cloudhealthsys.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal + on-prem expansion: need estimates and schedule

Hi Naomi,

Our board just greenlit the expansion we discussed — CloudHealth wants to add a second on-prem environment (east coast DR site) and isolate analytics workloads into a dedicated VPC cluster. We are working the renewal at the same time and would prefer to roll the new environment into the next 12-month term instead of a separate PO.

Key asks up front: a rough SOW, lead times for provisioning an on-prem cluster in our East-2 datacenter, and an updated cost delta if we move to a 12-month committed term that includes the additional capacity. Procurement will need a ballpark by next Tuesday to scope the internal approval.

Can you loop in the folks who provision hardware and confirm whether we need an on-site tech for network setup? Also attach any SOC2 / compliance evidence your team provides for on-prem deployments.

Thanks — Evan
Evan Brooks
Head of Platform Engineering
CloudHealth Systems
From: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@cloudhealthsys.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + on-prem expansion: need estimates and schedule

Hi Evan — great news, congrats to the team.

High level plan: we can onboard an east-coast on-prem cluster as a new private environment and carve an isolated VPC for analytics. Typical lead time for a standard on-prem site (assuming racks and networking are ready) is 6-8 weeks from PO + KVM access for our deployment agent; if you need a dedicated on-site runbook review we can add an on-site engineer for the network cutover (2-3 days).

Karthik — can you prepare a 1-page commercial summary that includes: (a) delta for on-prem cluster (GPU count + storage), (b) discount for folding the capacity into a 12-month committed term, and (c) one-time on-site engineering cost?

Kim — can you attach the tentative sizing worksheet and SOC2 evidence (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) we can share with their procurement/security?

Evan — Ill follow up with a draft SOW and a DocuSign-ready amendment we can push to procurement. If procurement wants a separate technical session with our infra team, happy to schedule next week.

Best,
Naomi
Accounts — Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@cloudhealthsys.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + on-prem expansion: need estimates and schedule

Hi all — attaching a working sizing sheet (onprem-sizing-sheet.xlsx) and the redwood-soc2-summary.pdf we usually include for Private deployments. Key notes from sizing:
- Proposed on-prem cluster: 8x A100 80GB + 200TB NVMe aggregate (analytics cluster isolated to a dedicated subnet).
- Expected sustained throughput for their batch workloads: ~12k tokens/sec; validated for current model family.
- Estimated provisioning lead time (software + config): 5-7 weeks if racks/networking amenities are preprovisioned; hardware lead time separate.

Security/note: SOC2 summary attached; for deeper evidence theyll want our audit pack (we can gate that behind an NDA / secure share). I recommend we plan a 60-minute tech session with CHS infra to walk the runbook and network flows.

Attachments: onprem-sizing-sheet.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf)

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@cloudhealthsys.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Commercial summary (Draft) — RDW-8921

Evan / team — draft commercial positions below for internal review before I share with procurement:
1) Term: 12-month committed term (start date aligned to existing renewal)
2) Capacity: Add east-coast on-prem cluster (8x A100 80GB, 200TB NVMe) + isolated analytics VPC cluster.
3) One-time: On-site engineering for network cutover — $18,000 (2-3 days; travel TBD).
4) Recurring: Additional committed capacity uplift — $35,000 / month (reflects 18% term consolidation discount vs month-to-month on Hosted/Dedicated pricing).
5) SOW & procurement: We will provide a single amendment to the existing contract to append the new environment and extend the term; SOW attached (CHS_Onprem_SOW_v3.pdf).

Open items: exact invoice cadence procurement prefers (monthly vs quarterly), and whether CHS will sign a single amendment or prefer a separate PO for the one-time on-site fee.

If that aligns Ill prepare a redlined amendment + DocuSign packet.

—Karthik
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Audrey Lane <audrey.lane@cloudhealthsys.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cloudhealthsys.com; evan.brooks@cloudhealthsys.com; monica.patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Renewal + on-prem expansion: need estimates and schedule

Thanks Karthik / Naomi — procurement here. The commercial summary looks reasonable. A couple of clarifications before we share with finance:
- Can you break out the recurring $35,000/mo into compute vs storage vs license line items for our internal chargeback?
- For the one-time on-site fee, procurement prefers that be invoiced on PO acceptance (not as a separate vendor invoice).
- Wed like a 30-day SLA uplift for the on-prem analytics cluster support window; please indicate whether that is included in the term price or an add-on.

If you can pull together a DocuSign-ready amendment with those line-item splits and the SLA language by EOD Friday we can route through internal approvals and then Ill confirm invoice cadence. Also please include the link to the audit pack gated behind the NDA.

Best,
Audrey Lane
Sr. Procurement Manager
CloudHealth Systems
